title: Write a short LinkedIn bio from your job title with Cohere
facebook: Tired of staring at a blank LinkedIn bio? You can type your job title into Cohere's chat and get a polished 2-3 sentence bio in minutes — then edit and use it on your profile, email signature, or conference bio.
